t: You're in St John's Wood Church Grounds, a disused graveyard that is now a public park. It's the only Local Nature Reserve in the City of Westminster, it's rated Grade 1 for nature conservation, and it has held a Green Flag Award since 2004. Westminster Council looks after it. The painter John Sell Cotman is buried here. He was an English landscape and marine painter, an etcher and illustrator, and a leading member of the Norwich School of painters. He died in 1842.
